options.label: •CH₃ (methyl radical, 7 valence electrons on C — one unpaired)
CH₃⁺ (methyl cation, 6 valence electrons on C — empty p-orbital)
CH₃⁻ (methyl anion, 8 valence electrons on C — filled lone pair)
CH₄ (methane, 8 valence electrons on C — fully paired)

explanation: A radical has one UNPAIRED electron. •CH₃ has 7 valence e⁻ on C (3 bonds + 1 unpaired). Cations have 6 e⁻ (empty p), anions have 8 (filled lone pair), neutral paired species have all e⁻ paired.
